text: Explicit component receipts show every kind of evidence (#296, #301). Their Markdown keeps each production component's proof row and adds separate views of conformance, runtime checks, assumptions and input provenance. Each view shows exact identities, source and contract hashes, selections, invocations, tool pins, the model and its bounds, observations, outcomes and diagnostics. Configuration stays apart from supplied results, an every-state claim stays apart from attempt coverage, and assumptions always read as assumed and unverified. Every caller-supplied value is escaped before it reaches the markup, and legacy receipts are unchanged byte for byte. No receipt shows an aggregate assurance, and the gate's recorded outcome never changes.
